ambiguities.g': P(minutes >= 5 | plays, as-of): production LightGBM binary params, seed 0, fitted on PLAYED rows of the RECENT_ROLE Cell-P frame (rostered, not OUT on the real-tip T-60 report, n_played_prior >= 5) dated strictly before each month block (2022 warm-up), features = RECENT_ROLE's R set; trained on played rows only so it is the conditional the mixture weight needs
ambiguities.g_eff: g' on regular-season rows (game_id prefix 002) that have a feature row; 0 elsewhere (postseason and play-in, and rows the T-60 report lists OUT who played): pre-tip-known hard route to A0
ambiguities.TAU: 0.90, fixed in the rule text; derived from the guard (minutes<5 slice <= +0.01) and the E2 slice arithmetic, not from any CRPS of an arm
ambiguities.constant gate: per month block the base rate of the label over the same training rows, with the same hard route: the gate with no features
ambiguities.placebo G: the five recent-role columns replaced by one strictly earlier row of the same player-season (RECENT_ROLE placebo, NaN for a player-season's first row); the rest of g''s columns real
ambiguities.placebo A1/SEQ: ensemble members replaced by the grid of ONE uniformly drawn strictly earlier row of the same player (near_miss_bundle_eval.past_only_index, seeds 1 and 2)
ambiguities.SHUF-G: g' trained on ONE permutation of the training labels per block (default_rng([0, block])), arm scored on real outcomes; compared with the constant-gate arm. Fails if the shuffled gate beats the constant gate by 0.001 with CI upper < 0
ambiguities.SHUF-C: labels drawn from A0's own predictive distribution (A0 is the truth); the blend gate refit on them; the arm must not beat A0 by 0.0025 on them
ambiguities.flag: E4' only: members ROUTER (A1) and SEQ; E1', E2' have one member plus the gate, so no carrier flag
ambiguities.family: BH over the six declared cells {E1' pts, E2' pts/reb/ast/fg3m, E4' pts}, separately for 2023 and 2024, two-sided game-clustered bootstrap p
